how_to_swap: 1. Pick an eye option PNG from entries.
2. Re-embed it as the eye diffuse texture for the target character (see character_mappings — for Pantera it's King_Eye_D in roster/pantera/attires/<attire>/pantera-*.glb).
3. To add a NEW character to the universal system: extract that character's eye diffuse texture, add a character_mappings entry naming its texture/material, and any entry PNG becomes usable on them.
4. To restore a character's original exactly: re-embed their original eye PNG.
source: Owner directive 2026-10-18: the yellow tiger eye is his 'I like' variant — must be a UNIVERSAL eye option usable on EVERY character, not just King/Pantera. All prior eye variants saved as swappable options, WWE/Tekken-style.

universal_format.description: Every entry is a square RGBA eye-iris diffuse texture. To use on a character, add a character_mappings entry: which texture name (material baseColor) it replaces and at what rect. No geometry changes — texture swap only, so it drops onto any character whose eye UVs you map.

placement_fields.rect: pixel rect to composite into (full replace if omitted)
placement_fields.replaces_texture: texture name in that character's GLB
